# WO-2026-08-13-01 — Finish vision honestly, then park it

## Acceptance criteria

> **⛔ THIS IS THE LAST CONCENTRATED VISION PACKAGE.** Warwick: *"Finish these. Bank the final measured
> vision result. Then PARK VISION IMPROVEMENT. **No Round 9. No prompt polishing. No new OCR architecture.
> No model bake-off. Move on.**"*

**AC1 — RESOLVE THE DETECTION REGRESSION. This is the blocker and it comes first.**
Baseline was 39/39 three times; WP-B15-33 returned 38/39 twice, losing page 25 the same way. **The
positional field is the only change to what the model was asked, and cause-versus-draw is unresolved.**
Run the **controlled comparison you said you had not run**: same code, positional field ON and OFF, enough
runs each to tell a regression from a draw. **If the field costs detection, the field loses** — Warwick's
39/39 is the decisive product number and no gate is worth trading it for. **Report which it was, with the
evidence.**

**AC2 — CALIBRATE THE GATE FROM MEASURED PRECISION, NOT FROM THE SCORE.**
Withholding 33 of 43 real lines is not a gate, it is an outage. **The freeze that forbade tuning is over —
but calibrate against MEASURED POSITIONAL PRECISION PER BAND, never against the resulting score.** Band 6
returning seven lines all claiming the same 4% of crop is the data telling you its own precision; a
tolerance that ignores that is fitting. **If a band's positional answers are degenerate, that band's
positions carry no evidential weight and the gate must fall back to not-assessed rather than withhold.**
**Warwick's bounds, quoted and absolute:** it may *"help establish whether an observation has plausible
visual support within its application-owned band/region"* · it *"may WITHHOLD PHOTO provenance and route
the observation to Cockpit"* · it *"may NEVER delete a detected line"* · it *"may NEVER be used as positive
authority to accept a line merely because the position looks plausible."*
**Honest outcome permitted:** if calibration cannot separate the phantoms from real lines, **say so and set
the gate to not-assessed rather than ship an outage.** That is a successful discharge.

**AC3 — STALE NEEDS-HUMAN, extended beyond duplicates.** AC1(a) of WP-B15-33 held — 0 stale duplicate
referrals, 3/3. **Warwick has widened it:** *"Once reconciliation resolves a line sufficiently, stale
'needs human' state must clear deterministically. **Cockpit must not ask Warwick questions about things
AsdAIr has already resolved.**"* Sweep every path that sets a human-attention flag and ensure resolution
clears it. Mutation-prove.

**AC4 — QUANTITY, to Warwick's stated rule, no more and no less.** No explicit purchase quantity → **1
retail unit**. `xN` / `N x item` → **N**. **Pack/count numbers are NOT purchase quantity** — *"Richmond 16
sausages = 1 pack. Ariel Pods 33 = 1 pack."* **Two genuine observations of the SAME physical line that
disagree → route to Cockpit, NEVER choose by model confidence.** And his honest limit, which you
established and he accepted: *"If a single visual reading is simply wrong and there is no contradictory
evidence, do not pretend deterministic code can magically know that."* **Do not manufacture a mechanism to
paper over that.**

**AC5 — THE SCORER COVERS ALL 39 FOR CORRECTNESS.** Warwick: *"Do not use a denominator that can pass while
an over-count such as '1 x 6pts' → 7 survives."* Publish the 12-line loss subset beside it, never instead.
**Also fix your own `incorrectCrossLineMerges` false positive** — the STRAWBERRY CAKE / Yazoo strawberry
join artefact you found and reported.

**AC6 — FREEZE AND BANK THE FINAL RESULT.** Same freeze discipline you have proven twice: HEAD unmoved, no
tracked file modified, byte-identical invocation, catalogue array identical, **nothing changed between
runs**. Three or more runs. Report each separately in the five metric families with calls, wall time and
cost. **This is the number that goes in Warwick's morning report and it is the last one vision produces.**

**AC7 — mutation-prove every deterministic invariant** you add or change. A gate no test can fail is not a
gate.

**AC8 — project cost before the first run.** Ceiling **$3.00** for this package including the AC1
comparison. Your last projection was 18% light because added prompt text cost more than allowed — **account
for that this time.** Report projected vs actual.

⛔ **NO ACCEPTANCE IS CLAIMED.** No production photograph event is exercised here.

- **AC2 calibration evidence**: the measured per-band positional precision the tolerance was derived FROM — not the score it produces.
- **Mutation proofs** for every invariant added or changed, each shown to bite.
- **The final frozen runs**, each reported separately, with the freeze proof.
- `bash scripts/secret-scan.sh --surface services/asdair/pipeline/agenticVisionPrototype` → exit code AND coverage (the accepted form).

**2. AC2 — calibrate from measured precision.** If it cannot separate phantoms from real lines, set
